change_summary: replace unbounded Command::output with one monotonic invocation deadline and typed termination outcomes
run Lean in a dedicated Unix process group and clean descendants after timeout or normal leader exit
retain the leader with waitid WNOWAIT until signals are sent, then bound leader reaping and group confirmation by one termination deadline
capture stdout and stderr through nonblocking cancellable workers with independent byte and drain budgets
bind supervisor version and all limits into content-addressed VerificationJob and KernelReceipt identity
propagate custom kernel contracts through corpus and assumption-minimization orchestration
reject non-Unix execution rather than asserting weaker process-tree guarantees
regressions: timeout cannot accept a late zero exit
descendant-held pipes are bounded and workers are cancelled and joined
signal termination is distinct from timeout and rejection
stdout and stderr quota overflow fail closed
capture-thread creation failure cleans the process group
post-SIGKILL leader polling obeys the termination deadline
custom limits remain bound through corpus and minimization jobs
